permissions.description: Help desk tickets and their lifecycle

actions.description: Raise a ticket as the caller
Reopen one of the caller's own resolved tickets
Triage any ticket and set its priority
Assign or reassign any ticket and list agents
Move any ticket to in progress and resolved
Comments on the caller's own tickets
Comment on the caller's own tickets

groups.name: Employees
groups.description: Everyone who may raise help desk tickets

groups.name: Support Agents
groups.description: IT staff who work help desk tickets

groups.name: Team Leads
groups.description: Leads who watch the support queue

roles.name: Employee
roles.description: Raises, follows, comments on and reopens their own tickets.

roles.name: Support Agent
roles.description: Works the whole queue: triages, assigns, progresses, resolves and comments.

roles.name: Team Lead
roles.description: Watches the queue and SLA breaches and assigns or reassigns tickets.
